what_changed: FCC conforms 47 CFR 64.1200(f)(9) to the court decision vacating the one-to-one prior express written consent rule; the diff restores the earlier definition of prior express written consent for telemarketing.
rationale: Prior express written consent governs telemarketing and advertising calls only, excluded by the test; servicing and collection calls rely on prior express consent, which is unchanged in the diff. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
